gen-gf-offside-gf-orienta: Offside spaces its letters wide, with curves that never quite close. Orienta, a plain sans with breathing counters, keeps things low-key, and the rolling-ball-pen line up top is what ties them together.
gen-gf-offside-gf-oxygen: Expressive and widely tracked, Offside draws every stroke at a single width, with curves that stay stubbornly open. Oxygen keeps its lowercase near capital height, so the two sit level.
gen-gf-offside-gf-parkinsans: Parkinsans holds one stroke thickness throughout and stays crisp when shrunk. Offside, widely tracked with curves that refuse to close, supplies the commanding headline voice while that sans stays tidy underneath.
gen-gf-offside-gf-pathway-extreme: Rounded letters here stay clearly open, with stubby ascenders and descenders under a big x-height. Pathway Extreme takes that compact build and lets Offside's smooth drawn-wire headline stretch out wide above it.
gen-gf-offside-gf-preahvihear: Offside spreads wide-tracked letters across the line, every stroke cut to the same gauge. But Preahvihear, a plain sans with a lofty x-height and open letter mouths, gives that uniform line a softer partner.
gen-gf-offside-gf-prompt: Prompt reads big and friendly, its small letters carrying generous, easy apertures. But Offside's lowercase n, its arch and stem matching, is the quality that holds the pair together.
gen-gf-offside-gf-pt-sans-caption: Offside lays out widely tracked letters in one flat line weight, every glyph alike. Then PT Sans Caption, a plain sans with big-bodied lowercase and inviting unclosed bowls, takes over in a softer register.
gen-gf-offside-gf-puritan: Approachable and clean, Puritan is a sans-serif whose rounded forms stay open, with oversized counters in e and a. But Offside's wide-tracked, pipe-like strokes supply the commanding edge here.
gen-gf-offside-gf-questrial: Questrial looks flat and stencil-cut, a sans-serif of single-weight strokes with short stalks rising above a tall band of letters. Offside's wide, level display voice makes the sharpest contrast.
gen-gf-offside-gf-radio-canada: Radio Canada reads tall and full in its lowercase c, s and z, a steady sans with clear curve endings. And Offside's wide, level headline hands off to text that would keep paragraphs flowing without fuss.
